correctness.rationale: For every finite order-(s,t) GQ, M M^T=(t+1)I+A_P and M^T M=(s+1)I+A_L. Point strongly regular parameters yield singular √((s+1)(t+1)) once, √(s+t) with h=st(s+1)(t+1)/(s+t) pairs and left/right null sectors. The five distance relations give a complete orthogonal decomposition into B0 once, B1 h times, u and v scalar sectors of multiplicities s²(st+1)/(s+t) and t²(st+1)/(s+t). Exact symbolic determinant factorization for f_j=r^j gives det B0=(1+str²)²(1-r²)(1-str²) and det B1=(1-r²)²(1+str⁴), so the sharp threshold, a=0 and nullity boundary are correct. Independently generated the 30-vertex symplectic quadrangle W(2), its full graph distances and four radial 30x30 spectra, all matching predicted 2x2 plus scalar block multiplicities. The finite check does not establish the general GQ theorem, which follows from the incidence decomposition.
